papers.sourceAudit: Q1–Q60 English adapted prompts and A–D option ordering checked against a public bilingual numbered 2025 index (ArivArk). TNPSC original booklet 27 MB could not be independently opened for page-wise verification; source status is secondary only, not official scanned-page certified. TNPSC official final key for Subject 497/QB CCSE-I-IAP25 is publicly linked but is not mapped to these adapted items; scoring disabled. Official final key marks Q6 and Q50 ALL, while the secondary reader says 'no final answer' for Q6/Q11/Q49; therefore its answer labels are not authoritative. Explicitly reconcile secondary reader Q11/Q49 'no final answer' claims against official final key (Q11 D; Q49 A), and Q6/Q50 official ALL. Q58 contains a condensed rural GDP reading passage. All original stems and exact original booklet figures still require TNPSC PDF visual verification before certification. Q49 is NOT an official ALL position: it has official final-key choice A despite the secondary reader's unresolved claim. Its only special marker is `secondaryReaderOfficialKeyDiscrepancy`. Q61–Q100 are now also editorially adapted and numbered against the same bilingual index. Official final key labels Q90 ALL (secondary page supplies a C choice) and Q88 B (secondary page falsely says no final); these conflicts are shown as ungraded review flags. Mathematical typesetting, especially Q95–Q100, requires source-booklet proofreading.
